summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by UBS Group AG, a foreign private issuer, furnishing a capitalization table as of June 30, 2026, alongside incorporation-by-reference statements for prior shelf registration and equity plans. The filing contains no transaction, no activist involvement, no strategic review, no tender offer, no spin-off, no restructuring, and no management departure. It is a periodic financial disclosure event, not a special situation.
